cpu: 4 Ampere Altra / ARM Neoverse-N1 cores, one thread per core
network: loopback; driver and both servers in one pod/cgroup
notes: Baseline trials are one-second single repetitions; release trials are three seconds with three repetitions.
AOF/RDB disabled for Redis; Flaro uses asynchronous WAL-logged PostgreSQL persistence.
The same Rust driver binary was used for baseline and release measurements.
